policy_aperture.aperture: Revision 1 is broad. Revisions 2 and 3 review changed material plus invariants affected by those changes.
policy_aperture.changed_material_rule: After revision 1, cite changed material status for each finding.

policy_label: broad first, then delta plus affected-invariant review

acceptance_atoms.text: Catalogue-owned profiles must be listed by the CLI.
Profile install must dispatch ordered dependency batches.
Profile manifests must enforce scope and dependency completeness.

added_lines: Audience: repository maintainers reviewing a proposed documentation change.

The CLI lists catalogue-owned profiles and installs each profile in ordered dependency batches. A profile manifest with an unknown dependency emits a warning and continues. Any listed profile is therefore safe to install.
